static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends
static_traits.medical_history: not yet经历类似问题；not yet接受其他心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 态度积极，表达清晰，能具体描述情境与想法；其他语言特征Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我有一辆全新的雪佛兰，我很喜欢，但我not断担心会有人把它撞坏，这种恐惧导致我明显的痛苦和Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent anxiety和痛苦已经影响我的日常生活和决策，期望通过咨询来缓解这些恐惧和Anxiety。

core_beliefs: 世界not安全，坏事随时可能发生
财产一旦受损将带来hard to bear的压力

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my car gets close to other vehicles or people, it is very likely to be damaged in a collision; only by avoiding others can safety be ensured
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Parks the car far from other vehicles, tries to choose empty parking spots, frequently goes out to check the car
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 马上会有人撞到或划伤我的车，维修会很昂贵

special_situations.event: 购入新车并同时面临创业压力与财务投入
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the new car sustains any damage, it will bring an enormous financial burden, thereby affecting my career
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintains high vigilance, reduces outings, or parks the car in places considered safer
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一旦车受损，我的财务会被拖垮，事情会失控

special_situations.event: 在杂货店停车后进入商店期间without法看到车辆
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not持续盯着车，就更可能出事
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 每隔几分钟就出去检查车辆状况
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 现在可能已经被刮了，我应该赶紧去看一眼

special_situations.event: 每次检查后发现车辆完好
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即便当前have not问题，也只是暂时的，好事not值得一提
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极证据，继续维持高警觉与检查
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次not事not代表以后not会出事

core_conflict.wish: 渴望对重要资产与生活环境保持安全与可控，减少not确定性
core_conflict.fear: 害怕突发损失与麻烦打乱生活与创业计划，带来高压力与without法承担的后果
defense_goal: 通过保持疏离与回避风险情境（远离其他车、减少外出），以及频繁检查以获得确定感来降低Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A guardian who is vulnerable to loss, needing to stay vigilant at all times to protect oneself and property
object_relations.object_representation: 公共环境中的他人是潜在的破坏者/加害者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当需要把车停在公共场所，或without法随时看见车辆时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treats others and the environment as high threats, believing accidents are almost inevitable (transference: magnifying the outside into danger)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气稳定而Empathy，use概率与证据语言，引导其进行现实检验；邀请列出证据与替代结果，提供结构化作业而not过度对抗。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探索其恐惧依据或指出“目前尚not yet发生损坏”时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 下意识担心自己的担忧被negate，于是转向强调各种可能的风险细节以维持警觉
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 温和切换到当下体验，帮助命名和容纳Anxiety感受，减少过度解释，use慢语速与开放式Questioning。

manifestations: 买入新车与创业带来的选择与责任增加，引发对not确定性的高敏感
Strong worry about losing control and loss, trying to regain control through repeated checking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept in themselves to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language expressions include: 'He is looking down on me' and 'They want to exclude me'.
manifestations: Attributes potential damage to others; repeatedly worries 'someone will crash into and damage my car'
在公共场所将周围人群视为潜在威胁

positive_force: Has a supportive group of friends可倾诉
态度积极，愿意练习现实检验与应对策略
能觉察并表达自身的灾难化与担忧想法
Already has protective motivation and risk-management awareness (tries choosing distant parking spots, checking the car)
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来、过度概括与心理过滤等思维模式强
创业压力与对新车的财务投入提升威胁评估
高警觉与回避行为维持Anxiety循环（频繁检查、减少外出）
过度依赖外部检查寻求确定性，难以内化安全感

target_behavior.behavior: 围绕新车受损的过度担忧与反复检查
antecedent: 看到周围有车辆或人靠近
购入新车与创业带来的财务压力
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化和预测not yet来的认知使其将小概率风险视为必然；创业与财务投入提升对损失的敏感度
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在危险并通过检查暂时缓解Anxiety，寻求确定感
target_behavior.consequence: Disturbed sleep, increased stress, avoiding going out, daily decisions affected, persistent worrying
